prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Baytown, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1380; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the intersection in Baytown, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please describe in your own words where you were driving and what you were doing just before the collision.

A: I was heading through the intersection on the green light. I had slowed a little because traffic ahead of me was backed up, but I was moving at a normal speed when I entered.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not until the last second. It came from my right side and I saw the front end of it appear at the edge of my window. I tried to brake, but there wasn't enough time.

Q: Where did your vehicle make contact with the other car?

A: On the driver's side, along the front door area. The other car struck my side and pushed my car sideways.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. I put my left hand out to brace myself and I landed hard on my wrist against the steering wheel and door frame. I was taken to the emergency room, and they told me the wrist was fractured. I'm still in a splint and I have a follow-up appointment next week.

Q: Did you receive any treatment at the scene?

A: The paramedics checked my blood pressure and asked me questions. They wanted me to go to the hospital, and I agreed to go.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add about the incident?

A: Only that I was following the traffic signal and I want to make sure my account is recorded accurately. Thank you.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
